notification_attempts_locale.name: notification_attempts_locale
notification_attempts_locale.value: ("notification_attempts"."locale" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_attempts"."locale" IN ('ar','en')) OR ("notification_attempts"."locale" IS NULL AND "notification_attempts"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "notification_attempts"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_attempts"."failure_code" IN ('LOCALE_MISSING','LOCALE_UNSUPPORTED'))

notification_attempts_phone.name: notification_attempts_phone
notification_attempts_phone.value: ("notification_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('SENT','FAILED','EXPIRED','SUPPRESSED') OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_phone" IS NULL) AND ("notification_attempts"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR "notification_attempts"."channel" <> 'whatsapp' OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_phone" IS NOT NULL) AND ("notification_attempts"."recipient_phone" IS NULL OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') AND ("notification_attempts"."channel" = 'whatsapp' OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_phone" IS NULL)

notification_attempts_email.name: notification_attempts_email
notification_attempts_email.value: ("notification_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('SENT','FAILED','EXPIRED','SUPPRESSED') OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_email" IS NULL) AND ("notification_attempts"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR "notification_attempts"."channel" <> 'email' OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_email" IS NOT NULL) AND ("notification_attempts"."channel" = 'email' OR "notification_attempts"."recipient_email" IS NULL) AND ("notification_attempts"."recipient_email" IS NULL OR (length("notification_attempts"."recipient_email") <= 254 AND "notification_attempts"."recipient_email" ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[a-z0-9.-]+[.][a-z]{2,63}$'))

notification_attempts_hash.name: notification_attempts_hash
notification_attempts_hash.value: octet_length("notification_attempts"."recipient_hash") = 32 AND (("notification_attempts"."channel" = 'whatsapp' AND "notification_attempts"."phone_last3" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_attempts"."phone_last3" ~ '^[0-9]{3}$') OR ("notification_attempts"."channel" = 'email' AND "notification_attempts"."phone_last3" IS NULL))

notification_attempts_execution.name: notification_attempts_execution
notification_attempts_execution.value: "notification_attempts"."status" <> 'SENDING' OR ("notification_attempts"."execution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_attempts"."sending_at" IS NOT NULL)

platform_whatsapp_audit_actor.name: platform_whatsapp_audit_actor
platform_whatsapp_audit_actor.value: ("platform_whatsapp_audit"."source" = 'STOP' AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."inbox_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."operator_id" IS NULL AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."reason" = 'RECIPIENT_STOP') OR ("platform_whatsapp_audit"."source" = 'MANUAL' AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."inbox_id" IS NULL AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."operator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_whatsapp_audit"."reason" IN ('OPERATOR_REQUEST','ABUSE_PREVENTION'))

auth_notification_attempts_authorization.name: auth_notification_attempts_authorization
auth_notification_attempts_authorization.value: ("auth_notification_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('PREPARED','SUPPRESSED') OR "auth_notification_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL) AND ("auth_notification_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('PENDING','SENDING','SENT') OR "auth_notification_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("auth_notification_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL OR "auth_notification_attempts"."authorized_at" < "auth_notification_attempts"."preparation_deadline")

auth_notification_attempts_fence.name: auth_notification_attempts_fence
auth_notification_attempts_fence.value: ("auth_notification_attempts"."execution_id" IS NULL) = ("auth_notification_attempts"."sending_at" IS NULL) AND ("auth_notification_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('SENDING','SENT') OR "auth_notification_attempts"."execution_id" IS NOT NULL)

auth_otp_challenges_terminal.name: auth_otp_challenges_terminal
auth_otp_challenges_terminal.value: ("auth_otp_challenges"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "auth_otp_challenges"."code_mac" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."derivation_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."verification_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("auth_otp_challenges"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' AND "auth_otp_challenges"."code_mac" IS NULL AND "auth_otp_challenges"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("auth_otp_challenges"."status" = 'CONSUMED') = ("auth_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)))

auth_otp_challenges_context.name: auth_otp_challenges_context
auth_otp_challenges_context.value:
jsonb_typeof("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context") = 'object'
        AND ("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context"->>'companyId') ~ '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
        AND ("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context"->>'businessId') ~ '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
        AND (("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context" ?& ARRAY['companyId','businessId','branchId','deviceId']
          AND "auth_otp_challenges"."device_context" - ARRAY['companyId','businessId','branchId','deviceId'] = '{}'::jsonb
          AND ("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context"->>'branchId') ~ '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$'
          AND ("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context"->>'deviceId') ~ '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$')
        OR ("auth_otp_challenges"."device_context" ?& ARRAY['purpose','companyId','businessId']
          AND "auth_otp_challenges"."device_context" - ARRAY['purpose','companyId','businessId'] = '{}'::jsonb
          AND "auth_otp_challenges"."device_context"->>'purpose' = 'STAFF_PERSONAL'))

file_cleanup_objects_state.name: file_cleanup_objects_state

leave_requests_decision_reason.name: leave_requests_decision_reason

leave_requests_revocation.name: leave_requests_revocation
leave_requests_revocation.value: ("leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("leave_requests"."status"='CANCELLED' AND "leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_at"<"leave_requests"."starts_at" AND "leave_requests"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("leave_requests"."revocation_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "leave_requests"."revocation_reason"=btrim("leave_requests"."revocation_reason") AND "leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL)

leave_requests_note.name: leave_requests_note
leave_requests_note.value: ("leave_requests"."note" IS NULL OR (char_length("leave_requests"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "leave_requests"."note"=btrim("leave_requests"."note"))) AND ("leave_requests"."type"<>'OTHER' OR "leave_requests"."note" IS NOT NULL)

leave_requests_kind.name: leave_requests_kind
leave_requests_kind.value: ("leave_requests"."kind"='FULL_DAY' AND "leave_requests"."start" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."end" IS NULL) OR ("leave_requests"."kind"='PARTIAL' AND "leave_requests"."from"="leave_requests"."to" AND "leave_requests"."start" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."end" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."start" ~ '^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "leave_requests"."end" ~ '^(?:[01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "leave_requests"."start"<"leave_requests"."end")

leave_requests_status.name: leave_requests_status
leave_requests_status.value: ("leave_requests"."status"='PENDING' AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decision_reason" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NULL) OR ("leave_requests"."status"='CANCELLED' AND "leave_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL AND (("leave_requests"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decision_reason" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NULL) OR ("leave_requests"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL))) OR ("leave_requests"."status" IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND "leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_by" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "leave_requests"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND (("leave_requests"."status"='APPROVED' AND "leave_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL) OR ("leave_requests"."status"='REJECTED' AND "leave_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("leave_requests"."rejection_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND ("leave_requests"."decision_reason" IS NULL OR "leave_requests"."decision_reason"="leave_requests"."rejection_reason"))))

attendance_sessions_close_pair.name: attendance_sessions_close_pair
attendance_sessions_close_pair.value: ("attendance_sessions"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "attendance_sessions"."clock_out" IS NULL AND "attendance_sessions"."closed_by" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_sessions"."status" <> 'OPEN' AND "attendance_sessions"."clock_out" >= "attendance_sessions"."clock_in" AND "attendance_sessions"."closed_by" IN ('EMPLOYEE','MISSED_OUT'))

attendance_sessions_geo.name: attendance_sessions_geo

attendance_sessions_out_binding_pair.name: attendance_sessions_out_binding_pair

attendance_sessions_location.name: attendance_sessions_location

attendance_sessions_out_location.name: attendance_sessions_out_location
